name: Like-Dislike and Ratings Posts/Products
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
Like-Dislike and Ratings Posts/Products is a lightweight, user-friendly plugin that lets users express feedback on posts and WooCommerce products with Like, Dislike, and Star Rating options.

Built with performance in mind, the plugin uses AJAX for seamless interaction and offers customization for labels, icon colors, display positions, and more.

🎯 Key Features

👍 Like / 👎 Dislike Buttons

  • Display interactive Like and Dislike buttons.
  • Customize label texts and icon colors.
  • Optionally show counts for Likes and Dislikes.

⭐ Star Ratings System

  • Display 1–5 star rating on posts and products.
  • Show average rating instantly.

⚡ AJAX-Powered Interaction

  • All actions (like/dislike/star) run smoothly without page reload.
  • Real-time updates for user feedback.

🛡️ Anti-Spam & Access Control

  • Restrict multiple votes via IP, cookies, or user login.
  • Allow or disallow guest voting.

🎨 Highly Customizable

  • Set custom label text before Like/Dislike buttons.
  • Choose icon colors individually for Like and Dislike.
  • Position controls: before/after content or buttons.
  • Fully responsive and theme-compatible.

🧰 Developer-Friendly

  • Clean, lightweight code.
  • Includes hooks and filters for developers.
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for Like-Dislike and Ratings Posts/Products.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  5. Configure settings under Settings > Like Dislike Posts/Products.
sections.faq:
❓ Can guests vote?

Yes, guest voting is supported using IP or cookie tracking.

❓ Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes! Works seamlessly on product pages and shop archives.

❓ Can I choose where the buttons appear?

Yes, you can choose to show buttons before or after content or product buttons.

❓ Can I customize icon styles and colors?

Yes. You can select individual colors for Like/Dislike icons and change label text.

❓ Is it mobile responsive?

Yes, the plugin is 100% responsive and works well on all devices.
